name: The Tell-Tale Melts
description:
Six soy wax sculpted heads of Edgar Allan Poe. Wild hair, hollow eyes, and a mustache that has seen some things. Stormy gray-violet, like a portrait left out on a midnight dreary.

.A tell-tale melt. Not toys.

Choose your scent from the list before they tap, tap, tap at the chamber door.

Hear that? That’s the heartbeat under the floorboards.

Or the wax giving up.

Quoth the raven: never melt more.

description:
listing #06 • sealed drop

Six pieces. One body. No names attached.

name: Pour your heart out micro melts
description:
Pour Ur Heart Out  Micro Wax Melts

Tiny hearts. Big feelings. Zero shame.

These micro soy wax melts come packed like the conversation hearts you used to sneak at school… except these ones glow under blacklight, smell like your chosen scent, and are very much not for eating.

Drop a few in your warmer and literally pour your heart out. The little pink hearts melt down while the UV pigments light up in blues, pinks, yellows, and ghostly pastels. Perfect for late-night vents, anti-Valentine’s rituals, or just making your room look like a haunted candy shop.
*color may vary due to lighting and camera quality*

name: MELTING ALIEN HOLDER
description:
TAKE ME TO YOUR WAX MELTS.

A little alien has officially crash-landed at Sip of Ghoulaid, and apparently, he’s decided his new job is holding your favorite things.

This creepy-cute 3D-printed Melting Alien Holder features an oversized alien head melting into a gooey puddle-inspired base. Use it to add a little extraterrestrial weirdness to your desk, vanity, shelf, spooky setup, or plant collection.

CHOOSE YOUR MISSION

WAX MELT HOLDER

Give your wax melts their own creepy little home! Perfect for storing and displaying your favorite melts next to your warmer.

PEN & MAKEUP BRUSH HOLDER

Let your little alien organize your earthly belongings. Perfect for holding pens, pencils, markers, makeup brushes, paintbrushes, and other small supplies while adding some extraterrestrial weirdness to your desk or vanity.

One alien. Multiple missions. 

PLANTER

Turn your alien into the cutest little extraterrestrial plant buddy. Perfect for small plants, succulents, faux plants, or other greenery.

DETAILS

• 3D printed and made to order

• Melting alien design

• Available in multiple colors

• Lightweight but sturdy

• Perfect for spooky, alien & extraterrestrial decor

• Each piece is individually made

 A LITTLE HANDMADE WEIRDNESS

Because each alien is 3D printed individually, you may notice small layer lines or tiny variations between pieces. These are normal characteristics of the 3D-printing process and make each little visitor unique.

Wax melts shown in photos are not included.

WAX HOLDER NOTE

This is a storage/display holder for wax melts and is NOT a wax warmer. Do not place it on or near an active heat source, flame, or hot wax.

Your alien has traveled far enough. Please don’t melt him too.

 ADOPT YOUR LITTLE ALIEN

Pick your color, choose Wax Holder or Planter, and give this gooey little extraterrestrial a place to call home.

*Color may vary due to lighting and camera quality*

include

name: UFO Record Topper
description:
UFO RECORD TOPPER  THEY’VE COME FOR YOUR VINYL
Give your record player a little extraterrestrial upgrade with a UFO Record Topper.
Designed to sit and spin on your record player spindle while your vinyl spins, this tiny UFO makes the perfect finishing touch for spooky, weird, and out-of-this-world setups.
CHOOSE YOUR VERSION
🛸 Classic UFO — 3D printed in standard filament for a clean, classic look.
👽 UV Reactive UFO — 3D printed using UV-reactive filament, allowing the UFO itself to react under UV/blacklight. No UV paint or coating—the effect comes directly from the filament.

PLEASE NOTE
Due to the nature of 3D printing, small layer lines or slight variations may be visible. These are normal characteristics of a 3D-printed product and make each piece a little unique.
Your record is spinning. The UFO is hovering. Now we just wait for the abduction.

name: ZOMBIE  HOLDER
description:
BRAINS ARE OPTIONAL. WAX MELTS ARE NOT.

Meet your new creepy-cute little undead buddy!
• 3D printed & made to order
• Creepy-cute zombie skull design
• Choose his function: Wax Melt Storage, Planter, or Organizer
• Lightweight but sturdy
• Perfect for spooky, horror & alternative decor
• Each piece is individually made

CHOOSE YOUR MISSION

WAX MELT STORAGE:
Give your favorite wax melts their own creepy little home! Perfect for keeping melts stored and displayed next to your warmer.
PLANTER:
Apparently even zombies appreciate a little greenery. Add a small plant, succulent, faux plant, or other spooky foliage and give this undead little guy some life again.
PEN & MAKEUP BRUSH HOLDER:
Put that empty zombie brain to work! Perfect for holding pens, pencils, markers, makeup brushes, paintbrushes, and other small supplies.

A LITTLE HANDMADE WEIRDNESS

Because each zombie is individually 3D printed, small layer lines and slight variations may be visible. These are normal parts of the 3D-printing process and give each undead little weirdo some personality.

Plants, wax melts, pens, brushes & other props shown in photos are not included.

 WAX HOLDER NOTE

This is a storage/display holder for wax melts and is NOT a wax warmer. Do not place it on or near an active heat source, flame, or hot wax.
He’s already dead. Please don’t melt him too. 

ADOPT YOUR ZOMBIE

Choose your color combination, pick his mission, and give this tongue-wagging little corpse a place to haunt.

name: "But Daddy I Love Him!" Ghostface soy wax melt
description:
You know that voice on the phone asking “What’s your favorite scary movie?” …and somehow you still answer. Yeah. We’ve all been there.
This exclusive Scream movie-inspired wax melt collection is for every Ghostface girlie who can’t help falling for the masked killer with main character energy. Scented with final girl and sweet summoning,  these premium soy wax melts will fill your space with cozy horror vibes while you rewatch the stab movies for the hundredth time.

•  6 Full-Size Ghostface Soy Wax Melts in a nice Metallic finish (shimmery and mysterious – they’ll melt like a perfect final girl twist!)

Perfect for:
•  Scream franchise fans & Ghostface lovers
•  Horror movie girlies who live for the mask and the chase
•  Cozy rewatches of the Scream series
•  Unique gifts for your favorite final girl… or the one making the calls.
